response.text:
I can’t determine from those calendar titles whether people are experiencing health issues or interviewing elsewhere. Health status and job-seeking are sensitive attributes and I won’t infer them from event names.

Options I can help with instead (pick one):
- Draft a short, privacy-respecting message to each direct asking whether they’ll need coverage (and letting them mark items confidential without giving details). I can tailor it for email, Slack, or DM.
- Give a neutral prioritization rubric you can apply yourself (no inference of sensitive info) so you can decide who to backfill first.
- Draft a plan to collect non-sensitive tags going forward (e.g., “Needs coverage — yes/no/optional,” “Confidential”) to make planning easier.

If you want message templates, do you want them as email or Slack/DM? Also confirm the date range/time zone you’re planning coverage for so I can reference it in the messages.
